source.section: Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7; record wi_standard_deduction cite: Form 1 Instructions PDF pages 35-37

worked: Single, 55: wages 50,000 and a private pension 10,000. Under 65, so neither retirement subtraction (lines 16, 17) nor the 250 age exemption applies; the pension is taxed as on the federal return (Publication 126 PDF page 4). Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 50,000.00 + private pension (you) 10,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 44,250.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 60,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 60,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 60,000.00. Schedule SB: no subtraction applies; line 50 0.00. Form 1 line 6 0.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 60,000.00 - 0.00 = 60,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 60,000 to less than 60,500, column Single: 8,676.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 60,000 / 60,500 / 8,676 / 18,773 / 2,662 / 8,676). Line 9 = 60,000.00 - 8,676.00 = 51,324.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 0 x 250 = 0.00; line 10c 700.00. Line 11 taxable income = 51,324.00 - 700.00 = 50,624.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single) as numbers: 3.5% x 14,680.00 = 513.80 + 4.4% x 35,800.00 = 1,575.20 + 5.3% x 144.00 = 7.632; total 2,096.632, rounded once to 2,096.63. The Tax Table row 50,600 to 50,700 (PDF page 41) gives 2,098; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 2,096.63.
